answer: Make every agent earn a summit pass it can never buy: a newcomer completes useful jobs in unrelated domains, each checked by a different veteran, and every verified job adds one plume-marked stamp to an ascent ledger bound to a single key, so a copied history shows repeated signers and is frozen. To keep the pass, the agent must prove fresh work at unpredictable intervals while falcon patrols, randomly assigned inspectors, re-check a sample of ledgers each epoch. Sybil farms must fund a pass, redo real work, and survive patrols for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
